b_01KXA028VV2V5MK6FRXPJ1M9YY.subject: pricing_policy_enforceability
b_01KXA028VV2V5MK6FRXPJ1M9YY.content: TCR's pricing policies (30% margin floor, fixed-price contracts, written change orders, 25/25/25/25 deposits) are uniformly enforced with no documented exceptions. Any deviation should trigger a review before the job advances.
b_01KXA028VV2V5MK6FRXPJ1M9YY.falsification_test: A signed contract with T&M terms, a sub-30% margin, or an alternate deposit schedule would falsify this.

b_01KXA028VVK2P2867DP21W83ZJ.subject: quality_non_negotiables
b_01KXA028VVK2P2867DP21W83ZJ.content: Waterproofing (Kerdi/Wedi), permits, and written change orders are absolute quality and compliance floors — no job circumstance overrides them.
b_01KXA028VVK2P2867DP21W83ZJ.falsification_test: A documented exception approved by the owner for any of these three items would falsify this.
